thread:
Iris: FYI scheduling a narrowly scoped infra apply tonight 20:00 UTC for release/2024.08. Scope: update route propagation for service-mesh, add a conditional canary route that shifts 5% traffic to new path, and create a cross-account IAM role for billing. Change window 20:00-20:30 UTC.
Iris: Need an apply owner (terraform + gate) and someone to write the short release blurb.
Noah: I'll own the apply and run the gate. Will be oncall. What are our rollback/safety-latch criteria?
Yara: Rollback triggers: deploybot apply failure; sustained 6+ 5xx/min for 5m; canary route error rate > 2% over baseline for 3 consecutive 1m windows; or p95 latency increase > 120ms for 5m. Safety latch: automatically revert canary route if errors cross threshold. Manual rollback command: `terraform apply -var='rollback=true'` or follow runbook step 3 to detach canary route.
runbook-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/infra/canary-route-2024.08  follow rollback and traffic reflow steps.
deploybot: preflight checks queued...
deploybot: preflight OK  plan succeeded, no unexpected drift for targeted resources. Provider pinned: aws v4.85.0 (lock sha: pqr321).
Noah: Local plan I'll run:```bash
cd infra/routing
terraform init -reconfigure -backend-config=prod.backend
terraform plan -out=plan.canary -var-file=prod.tfvars
```
Iris: Sequence: apply primary region (us-east-1) -> enable 5% canary route -> monitor 6m -> if stable, ramp to 20% then apply secondary region (eu-west-1). No auto-approve for ramp step.
Yara: Canary verification script: `./ops/canary-checks.sh us-east-1`  checks 200s, latency, header propagation, and billing assume-role. Script link: https://ci.internal/canary-checks.sh
Noah: Snapshotting state to s3://infra-backups/canary-2024-08/$(date +%s).tfstate before apply. Locking remote state.
deploybot: apply started by Noah at 1768880055 (us-east-1)
deploybot: apply completed (us-east-1) at 1768880100  success
Noah: Enabling 5% canary via infra flag manager now. Triggering traffic-shape at the load balancer.
Iris: Watch metrics closely. I tagged the service owner @Yara and alerting on canary-error-rate > 0.5%.
Yara: Canary checks running: 1m window: error rate 0.12%, p95 38ms, headers OK. Proceed to 20% ramp in 3m if stable.
Noah: Noting a small bump in 502s for dependent svc (0.7/min) but still below abort. Monitoring.
Noah: Ramping to 20% now. Approving secondary region plan only once canary holds 4m.
deploybot: canary-latch: threshold not crossed. Auto-safety-latch remains armed.
Noah: Canary hold at 20% for 4m: error rate steady 0.15%, p95 stable. Approving eu-west-1 plan.
deploybot: preflight for eu-west-1 OK  plan ready.
deploybot: apply started by Noah (eu-west-1) at 1768880165
deploybot: apply failed at 1768880180  error: remote state lock held by pipeline-7482.
Iris: Hold on. Do NOT force-unlock unless CI confirms no writer. Pinged pipeline owners.
Noah: Pipeline 7482 shows a long-running read job; I requested a lock release. Requeueing apply.
deploybot: apply re-queued...
deploybot: apply started by Noah (eu-west-1) at 1768880196
deploybot: apply completed (eu-west-1) at 1768880205  success
Yara: Post-apply checks: cross-account assume-role to billing succeeded, route propagation visible, canary remains healthy across regions. No surge in 5xx.
Iris: Updating release notes: "Infra: canary routing for service-mesh (5%->20% ramp) + billing cross-account role; route propagation fixes. Change window 20:00 UTC. See runbook for rollback steps."
release-helper: Release blurb drafted and linked to changelog.
Noah: Closing change window and releasing state lock. Dropping snapshot metadata after 24h. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
